mermaid.instructions: Use these tools for collaborative design workflows: creating and managing Mermaid diagrams, wireframes, markdown documents, and UI rendering. All diagram/document operations require project path and session name parameters. PORT: 9002 is only the port the server REQUESTS — under per-user coexistence a second user's server falls back to another port and writes the real one to $MERMAID_DATA_DIR/port (~/.mermaid-collab/port). Set COLLAB_API_PORT to that value, as scripts/statusline.sh and the notification hooks already do. Pointing at another user's server fails quietly rather than loudly: check_server_health reports healthy because that server is healthy, list_sessions returns [] because those are the other user's sessions, and the first hard error is an EACCES writing into a home directory that server cannot traverse.
